Clark Bars
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:04pm

Ingredients




1 (16 ounce) package graham crackers, crumbled
1 cup melted butter
cup peanut butter
cup confectioners' sugar
2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
1 (14 ounce) can sweetened condensed milk

Preparation

1 Grease a 9x13 inch pan. Mix graham cracker crumbs, butter, peanut butter and powdered sugar together in a large mixing bowl. Press the mixture into the prepared pan. In a small pot melt chocolate chips and condensed milk together over a low heat. Stir until well mixed. Spread the chocolate mixture over the peanut butter mixture. Chill the cookie-bars for 4 hours. Cut and serve. 2 Clark Bars 14
